name: tufte
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：tufte。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Apply Edward Tufte's principles to any data visualization, chart, dashboard, or infographic. Use when the user asks to produce, design, critique, or improve a chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile, table-with-data, sparkline, small multiple, time series, distribution plot, choropleth, or any other visual that communicates quantitative or categorical information. Also triggers on words like "visualize"
